entities.name: PMID:27505036
observations: Retrospective SEARCH cohort of 837 men with M0/Mx CRPC (306 Black, 531 non-Black) at five VA hospitals; Black and non-Black men had no significant differences in any metastasis, bone metastasis, imaging timing, or overall survival (all P>0.2). Authors concluded race was not prognostic after M0/Mx CRPC diagnosis.

entities.name: PMID:39267888
observations: US community-urology retrospective cohort included 406 nmCRPC patients initiating apalutamide; metastasis-free survival was 89.7% at 12 months and 75.4% at 24 months overall, and outcomes were descriptively similar in Black and non-Black patients; no adjusted race effect estimate was reported in the abstract.
